create_VocabInfo_from_map: create a VocabInfo instance from a dictionary mapping token names to integer IDs
get_special_token_ids: get the BOS, EOS, BOI, EOI, PAD, and EOT special token IDs from a VocabInfo instance
list_image_tokens: list all image tokens from a VocabInfo instance by filtering tokens that start with IMGIMG
build_VocabTranslation_for_device: build a VocabTranslation instance from VocabInfo to convert between BPE and image token IDs on a device
convert_bpe_tokens_to_image: convert a batch of BPE token tensors to image token tensors using VocabTranslation convert_bpe2img
